# Gitea API

### Gitea API reference

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/introduction`

# Gitea API reference {#gitea-api-reference}


Gitea is a self-hosted Git service written in Go. This site is a
[Sourcey](https://sourcey.com)-generated documentation set built directly from
Gitea's own OpenAPI description, so every endpoint, parameter and schema on the
**API Reference** tab is taken from source rather than retyped.


## The source this site is built from {#the-source-this-site-is-built-from}


| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Repository | [go-gitea/gitea](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea) |
| Pinned commit | `4f5a3e13e5f3aca85d830e3a9024c893b0bbf1e1` (release tag `v28.3.0`) |
| Spec file | `templates/swagger/v1-openapi3.generated.json` |
| Spec format | OpenAPI 3.0.3 |
| License | MIT (see `LICENSE` in the repository) |
| Adapter | Sourcey `openapi()` |

The Gitea API description is generated by Gitea's own tooling from Go source
annotations, then published as `v1-openapi3.generated.json`. Pinning to a tagged
release means the reference matches the code a given Gitea instance runs.


## How to use the reference {#how-to-use-the-reference}


- Use the **API Reference** tab and its search to jump straight to an operation,
  request body or response schema.
- Every operation lists its HTTP method, path, parameters, request body and the
  documented responses.
- Authentication is described by seven security schemes in the spec (see
  [Coverage](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/coverage.md) for the count). In practice you send either an
  `Authorization: token <token>` header or a `token` query parameter.


## What this site does and does not claim {#what-this-site-does-and-does-not-claim}


This is a faithful rendering of the upstream spec at the pinned commit. Where
the upstream spec is thin, this site is thin for the same reason and says so on
the [Known gaps](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/gaps.md) page rather than papering over it.


### Coverage

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/coverage`

# Coverage {#coverage}


These numbers are counted directly from
`templates/swagger/v1-openapi3.generated.json` at commit
`4f5a3e13e5f3aca85d830e3a9024c893b0bbf1e1` (tag `v28.3.0`). They describe the
documented surface, not the whole of Gitea.

| Concept | Count |
| --- | --- |
| Paths | 342 |
| Operations (method + path) | 537 |
| Tag groups | 9 |
| Reusable schemas (`components.schemas`) | 234 |
| Security schemes | 7 |
| Deprecated operations | 4 |


## Operations by tag {#operations-by-tag}


Gitea groups its API into nine tags. The counts below are operations per tag,
from the spec:

| Tag | Operations |
| --- | --- |
| repository | 222 |
| user | 93 |
| organization | 83 |
| issue | 72 |
| admin | 33 |
| miscellaneous | 14 |
| package | 9 |
| notification | 7 |
| settings | 4 |


## Security schemes {#security-schemes}


The description declares seven schemes: `AccessToken`, `AuthorizationHeaderToken`,
`BasicAuth`, `SudoHeader`, `SudoParam`, `TOTPHeader` and `Token`. Six are
`apiKey` schemes and one (`BasicAuth`) is HTTP basic auth.


## Servers {#servers}


The spec's `servers` entry is a build placeholder, `/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1`.
A real deployment serves the API under its own instance URL, for example
`https://gitea.example.com/api/v1`. See [Known gaps](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/gaps.md) for why this
matters to codegen tools.


### Known gaps

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/gaps`

# Known gaps {#known-gaps}


These are real gaps in the pinned description
(`templates/swagger/v1-openapi3.generated.json` at
`4f5a3e13e5f3aca85d830e3a9024c893b0bbf1e1`). Each one is reproducible from the
file; the counts were produced with a small JSON script over the spec. They are
listed here because a generated reference can only be as complete as its source.

- **Most operations have no `description`.** 516 of 537 operations (about 96%)
  carry a `summary` but no `description`. For example `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}`
  has `summary: "Get a repository"` and no `description`; `GET /admin/cron` has
  `summary: "List cron tasks"` and no `description`. A one-line summary is enough
  to label a page, but not to explain scopes, pagination or side effects.

- **Error responses are often undocumented.** 55 of 537 operations declare no
  `4xx` or `5xx` response at all. Clients generated from the spec therefore have
  no typed error surface for those endpoints, even though Gitea returns structured
  API errors in practice.

- **Some schemas are undocumented.** 36 of the 234 reusable schemas in
  `components.schemas` have no `description`, so a reader sees a field list with
  no prose about what the object represents.

- **One security scheme has no description.** Of the seven schemes, `BasicAuth`
  is the only one without a `description`; the other six explain their usage.

- **The `version` field is a build placeholder.** `info.version` is
  `0.0.0+GITEA-API-APP-VERSION`. Because the version is substituted at build time,
  a spec taken from a source tree does not carry the real release number, which
  makes it hard to tell which API version a downloaded file describes.

- **The `servers` URL is a placeholder.** `servers[0].url` is
  `/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1`. Code generators that trust `servers` will emit a
  base path that no real instance uses; a pinned instance URL or a documented
  `{suburl}` variable would make generated clients usable without editing.

- **Deprecated operations carry no migration note.** Four operations are marked
  `deprecated` (for example `POST /org/{org}/repos` and the issue-comment
  `DELETE`/`PATCH` pair), but none of them points at a replacement, so a reader
  cannot tell what to migrate to.

- **There is no `externalDocs` link.** The description has no top-level
  `externalDocs`, so there is no in-spec pointer to the human Gitea API guide for
  the concepts the reference leaves out.


## What is in good shape {#what-is-in-good-shape}


- Every operation has a stable `operationId` and a `summary` (0 missing).
- Every non-path parameter has a `description` (0 missing).
- All nine tag groups are declared with a description.
- The file is valid OpenAPI 3.0.3 and parses cleanly.


### Gitea API

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/api`

# Gitea API

This documentation describes the Gitea API.

Version: 0.0.0+GITEA-API-APP-VERSION

Authentication:
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.


### Lists all jobs

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-actions-jobs-get`

# Lists all jobs

`GET /admin/actions/jobs`

Authentication (security requirement alternatives):

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },
  {
    "Token": []
  },
  {
    "AccessToken": []
  },
  {
    "AuthorizationHeaderToken": []
  },
  {
    "SudoParam": []
  },
  {
    "SudoHeader": []
  },
  {
    "TOTPHeader": []
  }
]
```

- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `status` (query, string, optional) - workflow status (requested, pending, queued, in_progress, failure, success, skipped)
  Type: string

- `page` (query, integer, optional) - page number of results to return (1-based)
  Type: integer

- `limit` (query, integer, optional) - page size of results
  Type: integer

- `sort` (query, string, optional) - sort jobs by attribute. Supported values are "id". Default is "id"
  Type: string

- `order` (query, string, optional) - sort order, either "asc" (ascending) or "desc" (descending). Default is "asc"
  Type: string

Responses:

- 200: WorkflowJobsList

Content type: application/json

Type: ActionWorkflowJobsResponse

ActionWorkflowJobsResponse returns ActionWorkflowJobs

Schema: [ActionWorkflowJobsResponse](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/actionworkflowjobsresponse.md)

- `jobs` (optional)
  Type: Array<ActionWorkflowJob>
  
  Items:
    Reference: [ActionWorkflowJob](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/actionworkflowjob.md); Type: ActionWorkflowJob
    
    ActionWorkflowJob represents a WorkflowJob

- `total_count` (optional)
  Type: integer, int64

- 400: APIError is error format response

- 404: APINotFound is a not found empty response

- 422: APIValidationError is error format response related to input validation

## Examples

### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1/admin/actions/jobs' \
  -H 'Authorization: Basic WU9VUl9VU0VSTkFNRTpZT1VSX1BBU1NXT1JE'
```

### JavaScript

```javascript
const response = await fetch('https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1/admin/actions/jobs', {
  method: 'GET',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': 'Basic WU9VUl9VU0VSTkFNRTpZT1VSX1BBU1NXT1JE',
  },
});

const data = await response.text();
```

### Python

```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    'https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1/admin/actions/jobs',
    headers={
        'Authorization': 'Basic WU9VUl9VU0VSTkFNRTpZT1VSX1BBU1NXT1JE',
    },
)
print(response.text)
```

```bash
  "disabled": true
```

```javascript
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  },

});
```

`POST /admin/hooks`

Authentication (security requirement alternatives):

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },

    "Token": []
  },
  {
    "AccessToken": []
  },

  },
```

- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Request body: application/json (required)

Type: CreateHookOption

CreateHookOption options when create a hook

Schema: [CreateHookOption](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/createhookoption.md)

- `active` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  Whether the webhook should be active upon creation
  
  default: false

- `authorization_header` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Authorization header to include in webhook requests

- `branch_filter` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Branch filter pattern to determine which branches trigger the webhook

- `config` (required)
  Reference: [CreateHookOptionConfig](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/createhookoptionconfig.md); Type: CreateHookOptionConfig
  
  CreateHookOptionConfig has all config options in it
  required are "content_type" and "url" Required

- `events` (optional)
  Type: Array<string>
  
  List of events that will trigger this webhook
  
  Items:
    Type: string

- `name` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Optional human-readable name for the webhook

- `type` (required)
  Type: string
  
  The type of the webhook to create
  
  enum: ["dingtalk","discord","gitea","gogs","msteams","slack","telegram","feishu","wechatwork","packagist"]

Responses:

- 201: Hook

Content type: application/json

Type: Hook

Hook a hook is a web hook when one repository changed

Schema: [Hook](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/hook.md)

- `active` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  Whether the webhook is active and will be triggered

- `authorization_header` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Authorization header to include in webhook requests

- `branch_filter` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Branch filter pattern to determine which branches trigger the webhook

- `config` (optional)
  Type: object
  
  Configuration settings for the webhook
  
  Additional properties: 
    Type: string

- `created_at` (optional)
  Type: string, date-time
  
  The date and time when the webhook was created

- `events` (optional)
  Type: Array<string>
  
  List of events that trigger this webhook
  
  Items:
    Type: string

- `id` (optional)
  Type: integer, int64
  
  The unique identifier of the webhook

- `name` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Optional human-readable name for the webhook

- `type` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  The type of the webhook (e.g., gitea, slack, discord)

- `updated_at` (optional)
  Type: string, date-time
  
  The date and time when the webhook was last updated

## Examples

```bash

  -H 'Authorization: Basic WU9VUl9VU0VSTkFNRTpZT1VSX1BBU1NXT1JE' \

  --data-raw '{
```

```bash
  ],
  "name": "string"
```

### JavaScript

```javascript
const body = `{
  "active": true,
  "authorization_header": "string",
  "branch_filter": "string",
  "config": {},
  "events": [
    "string"
  ],
  "name": "string"
}`;

const response = await fetch('https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1/admin/hooks/0', {
  method: 'PATCH',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': 'Basic WU9VUl9VU0VSTkFNRTpZT1VSX1BBU1NXT1JE',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  },
  body,
});

const data = await response.text();
```

### Python

```python
import requests

body = '''{
  "active": true,
  "authorization_header": "string",
  "branch_filter": "string",
  "config": {},
  "events": [
    "string"
  ],
  "name": "string"
}'''

response = requests.patch(
    'https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1/admin/hooks/0',
    data=body.encode('utf-8'),
    headers={
        'Authorization': 'Basic WU9VUl9VU0VSTkFNRTpZT1VSX1BBU1NXT1JE',
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
)
print(response.text)
```

```json
    "AuthorizationHeaderToken": []
  },
  {
    "SudoParam": []
  },
  {
    "SudoHeader": []
  },
  {
    "TOTPHeader": []
  }
]
```

- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `source_id` (query, integer, int64, optional) - ID of the user's login source to search for
  Type: integer, int64

- `login_name` (query, string, optional) - identifier of the user, provided by the external authenticator
  Type: string

- `page` (query, integer, optional) - page number of results to return (1-based)
  Type: integer

- `limit` (query, integer, optional) - page size of results
  Type: integer

- `sort` (query, string, optional) - sort users by attribute. Supported values are "name", "created", "updated" and "id". Default is "name"
  Type: string

- `order` (query, string, optional) - sort order, either "asc" (ascending) or "desc" (descending). Default is "asc", ignored if "sort" is not specified.
  Type: string

- `q` (query, string, optional) - search term (username, full name, email)
  Type: string

- `visibility` (query, string, optional) - visibility filter. Supported values are "public", "limited" and "private".
  Type: string

- `is_active` (query, boolean, optional) - filter active users
  Type: boolean

- `is_admin` (query, boolean, optional) - filter admin users
  Type: boolean

- `is_restricted` (query, boolean, optional) - filter restricted users
  Type: boolean

- `is_2fa_enabled` (query, boolean, optional) - filter 2FA enabled users
  Type: boolean

- `is_prohibit_login` (query, boolean, optional) - filter login prohibited users
  Type: boolean

Responses:

- 200: UserList

Content type: application/json

Type: Array<User>

Items:
  Reference: [User](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/user.md); Type: User
  
  User represents a user

### Create a repository on behalf of a user

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-admin-users-username-repos-post`

# Create a repository on behalf of a user

`POST /admin/users/{username}/repos`

Authentication (security requirement alternatives):

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },
  {
    "Token": []
  },
  {
    "AccessToken": []
  },
  {
    "AuthorizationHeaderToken": []
  },
  {
    "SudoParam": []
  },
  {
    "SudoHeader": []
  },
  {
    "TOTPHeader": []
  }
]
```

- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `username` (path, string, required) - username of the user who will own the created repository
  Type: string

Request body: application/json (required)

Type: CreateRepoOption

CreateRepoOption options when creating repository

Schema: [CreateRepoOption](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/createrepooption.md)

- `auto_init` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  Whether the repository should be auto-initialized?

- `default_branch` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  DefaultBranch of the repository (used when initializes and in template)

- `description` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Description of the repository to create

- `gitignores` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Gitignores to use

- `issue_labels` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Label-Set to use

- `license` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  License to use

- `name` (required)
  Type: string
  
  Name of the repository to create
  
  uniqueItems: true

- `object_format_name` (optional)
  Type: ObjectFormatName
  
  ObjectFormatName of the underlying git repository, empty string for default (sha1)
  
  allOf:
    Reference: [ObjectFormatName](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/objectformatname.md); Type: ObjectFormatName
    
    enum: ["sha1","sha256"]

- `private` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  Whether the repository is private

- `readme` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Readme of the repository to create

- `template` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  Whether the repository is template

- `trust_model` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  TrustModel of the repository
  
  enum: ["default","collaborator","committer","collaboratorcommitter"]

Responses:

- 201: 

- 400: APIError is error format response

- 403: APIForbiddenError is a forbidden error response

- 404: APINotFound is a not found empty response

- 409: APIError is error format response

- 422: APIValidationError is error format response related to input validation

## Examples

### cURL

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1/admin/users/string/repos' \
  -H 'Authorization: Basic WU9VUl9VU0VSTkFNRTpZT1VSX1BBU1NXT1JE' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-raw '{
  "auto_init": true,
  "default_branch": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "gitignores": "string",
  "issue_labels": "string",
  "license": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "private": true,
  "readme": "string",
  "template": true,
  "trust_model": "default"
}'
```


### List users's notification threads

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-notifications-get`

# List users's notification threads

`GET /notifications`

Authentication (security requirement alternatives):

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },
  {
    "Token": []
  },
  {
    "AccessToken": []
  },
  {
    "AuthorizationHeaderToken": []
  },
  {
    "SudoParam": []
  },
  {
    "SudoHeader": []
  },
  {
    "TOTPHeader": []
  }
]
```

- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `all` (query, boolean, optional) - If true, show notifications marked as read. Default value is false
  Type: boolean

- `status-types` (query, Array<string>, optional) - Show notifications with the provided status types. Options are: unread, read and/or pinned. Defaults to unread & pinned.
  Type: Array<string>
  
  Items:
    Type: string

- `subject-type` (query, Array<string>, optional) - filter notifications by subject type
  Type: Array<string>
  
  Items:
    Type: string
    
    enum: ["issue","pull","commit","repository"]

- `since` (query, string, date-time, optional) - Only show notifications updated after the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format
  Type: string, date-time

- `before` (query, string, date-time, optional) - Only show notifications updated before the given time. This is a timestamp in RFC 3339 format
  Type: string, date-time

- `page` (query, integer, optional) - page number of results to return (1-based)
  Type: integer

- `limit` (query, integer, optional) - page size of results
  Type: integer

Responses:

- 200:

```javascript
  },
```

- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.

  Type: string

Type: CreateRepoOption

CreateRepoOption options when creating repository

Schema: [CreateRepoOption](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/createrepooption.md)

  Type: string

  Type: string

  Type: ObjectFormatName
  
  ObjectFormatName of the underlying git repository, empty string for default (sha1)
  
  allOf:
    Reference: [ObjectFormatName](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/objectformatname.md); Type: ObjectFormatName
    
    enum: ["sha1","sha256"]

  Type: boolean
  
  Whether the repository is private

- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.

### Create a hook

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-hooks-post`

# Create a hook

`POST /orgs/{org}/hooks`

Authentication (security requirement alternatives):

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },
  {
    "Token": []
  },
  {
    "AccessToken": []
  },
  {
    "AuthorizationHeaderToken": []
  },
  {
    "SudoParam": []
  },
  {
    "SudoHeader": []
  },
  {
    "TOTPHeader": []
  }
]
```

- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `org` (path, string, required) - name of the organization
  Type: string

Request body: application/json (required)

Type: CreateHookOption

CreateHookOption options when create a hook

Schema: [CreateHookOption](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/createhookoption.md)

- `active` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  Whether the webhook should be active upon creation
  
  default: false

- `authorization_header` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Authorization header to include in webhook requests

- `branch_filter` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Branch filter pattern to determine which branches trigger the webhook

- `config` (required)
  Reference: [CreateHookOptionConfig](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/createhookoptionconfig.md); Type: CreateHookOptionConfig
  
  CreateHookOptionConfig has all config options in it
  required are "content_type" and "url" Required

- `events` (optional)
  Type: Array<string>
  
  List of events that will trigger this webhook
  
  Items:
    Type: string

- `name` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Optional human-readable name for the webhook

- `type` (required)
  Type: string
  
  The type of the webhook to create
  
  enum: ["dingtalk","discord","gitea","gogs","msteams","slack","telegram","feishu","wechatwork","packagist"]

Responses:

- 201: Hook

Content type: application/json

Type: Hook

Hook a hook is a web hook when one repository changed

Schema: [Hook](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/hook.md)

- `active` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  Whether the webhook is active and will be triggered

- `authorization_header` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Authorization header to include in webhook requests

- `branch_filter` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Branch filter pattern to determine which branches trigger the webhook

- `config` (optional)
  Type: object
  
  Configuration settings for the webhook
  
  Additional properties: 
    Type: string

- `created_at` (optional)
  Type: string, date-time
  
  The date and time when the webhook was created

- `events` (optional)
  Type: Array<string>
  
  List of events that trigger this webhook
  
  Items:
    Type: string

- `id` (optional)
  Type: integer, int64
  
  The unique identifier of the webhook

- `name` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Optional human-readable name for the webhook

- `type` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  The type of the webhook (e.g., gitea, slack, discord)

- `updated_at` (optional)
  Type: string, date-time
  
  The date and time when the webhook was last updated

- 404: APINotFound is a not found empty response

## Examples

### cURL

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1/orgs/string/hooks' \
  -H 'Authorization: Basic WU9VUl9VU0VSTkFNRTpZT1VSX1BBU1NXT1JE' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-raw '{
  "active": false,
  "authorization_header": "string",
  "branch_filter": "string",
  "config": {},
  "events": [
    "string"
  ],
  "name": "string",
  "type": "dingtalk"
}'
```

### Get a hook

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-orgs-org-hooks-id-get`

# Get a hook

`GET /orgs/{org}/hooks/{id}`

Authentication (security requirement alternatives):

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },
  {
    "Token": []
  },
  {
    "AccessToken": []
  },
  {
    "AuthorizationHeaderToken": []
  },
  {
    "SudoParam": []
  },
  {
    "SudoHeader": []
  },
  {
    "TOTPHeader": []
  }
]
```

- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `org` (path, string, required) - name of the organization
  Type: string

- `id` (path, integer, int64, required) - id of the hook to get
  Type: integer, int64

Responses:

- 200: Hook

Content type: application/json

Type: Hook

Hook a hook is a web hook when one repository changed

Schema: [Hook](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/hook.md)

- `active` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  Whether the webhook is active and will be triggered

- `authorization_header` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Authorization header to include in webhook requests

- `branch_filter` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Branch filter pattern to determine which branches trigger the webhook

- `config` (optional)
  Type: object
  
  Configuration settings for the webhook
  
  Additional properties: 
    Type: string

- `created_at` (optional)
  Type: string, date-time
  
  The date and time when the webhook was created

- `events` (optional)
  Type: Array<string>
  
  List of events that trigger this webhook
  
  Items:
    Type: string

- `id` (optional)
  Type: integer, int64
  
  The unique identifier of the webhook

- `name` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Optional human-readable name for the webhook

- `type` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  The type of the webhook (e.g., gitea, slack, discord)

- `updated_at` (optional)
  Type: string, date-time
  
  The date and time when the webhook was last updated

- 404: APINotFound is a not found empty response

```javascript
  "color": "#00aabb",
  "description": "string",
  "exclusive": false,
  "is_archived": false,
  "name": "string"
}`;

const response = await fetch('https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1/orgs/string/labels/0', {
  method: 'PATCH',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': 'Basic WU9VUl9VU0VSTkFNRTpZT1VSX1BBU1NXT1JE',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  },
  body,
});

const data = await response.text();
```

### Python

```python
import requests

body = '''{
  "color": "#00aabb",
  "description": "string",
  "exclusive": false,
  "is_archived": false,
  "name": "string"
}'''

response = requests.patch(
    'https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1/orgs/string/labels/0',
    data=body.encode('utf-8'),
    headers={
        'Authorization': 'Basic WU9VUl9VU0VSTkFNRTpZT1VSX1BBU1NXT1JE',
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
)
print(response.text)
```

- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `org` (path, string, required) - name of the organization
  Type: string

- `id` (path, integer, int64, required) - id of the project
  Type: integer, int64

- `issue_id` (path, integer, int64, required) - global id of the issue, not the repository-local index
  Type: integer, int64

Request body: application/json

Type: MoveProjectIssueOption

MoveProjectIssueOption represents options for moving an issue between columns

Schema: [MoveProjectIssueOption](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/moveprojectissueoption.md)

- `column_id` (required)
  Type: integer, int64
  
  Target column to move the issue into

- `sorting` (optional)
  Type: integer, int64
  
  Position within the column, ascending. Omit to append. Negative values sort above
  the rest, equal values are ordered newest first.

Responses:

- 204: APIEmpty is an empty response

- 403: APIForbiddenError is a forbidden error response

- 404: APINotFound is a not found empty response

- 422: APIValidationError is error format response related to input validation

- 423: APIRepoArchivedError is an error that is raised when an archived repo should be modified

  Type: boolean

  Type: string
  
  TrustModel of the repository

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },
  {
    "Token": []
  },
  {

  },

  },

  },

]
```

- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.

  Type: string

Type: CreateTeamOption

CreateTeamOption options for creating a team

Schema: [CreateTeamOption](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/createteamoption.md)

- `can_create_org_repo` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  Whether the team can create repositories in the organization

- `description` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  The description of the team

- `includes_all_repositories` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  Whether the team has access to all repositories in the organization

- `name` (required)
  Type: string

- `permission` (optional)
  Type: RepoWritePermission
  
  All units have this permission (read/write/admin)
  
  allOf:
    Reference: [RepoWritePermission](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/repowritepermission.md); Type: RepoWritePermission
    
    enum: ["read","write","admin"]

  Type: Array<string>
  
  Deprecated: This variable should be replaced by UnitsMap and will be dropped in later versions.

  ```json
    "repo.packages",
    "repo.code",
    "repo.issues",
  ```

  ```json
    "repo.projects": "none",
    "repo.pulls": "owner",
    "repo.releases": "none",
    "repo.wiki": "admin"
  }
  ```
  
  Additional properties: 
    Type: string

- `visibility` (optional)
  Type: TeamVisibility
  
  Team visibility within the organization. Defaults to "private".
  
  allOf:
    Reference: [TeamVisibility](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/teamvisibility.md); Type: TeamVisibility
    
    enum: ["public","limited","private"]

Responses:

- 201: Team

Content type: application/json

Type: Team

Team represents a team in an organization

Schema: [Team](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/team.md)

- `can_create_org_repo` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  Whether the team can create repositories in the organization

- `description` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  The description of the team

- `id` (optional)
  Type: integer, int64
  
  The unique identifier of the team

- `includes_all_repositories` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  Whether the team has access to all repositories in the organization

- `name` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  The name of the team

- `organization` (optional)
  Reference: [Organization](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/organization.md); Type: Organization
  
  Organization represents an organization

  Reference: [AccessLevelName](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/accesslevelname.md); Type: AccessLevelName

  ```json
    "repo.releases": "none",
    "repo.wiki": "admin"
  }
  ```
  
  Additional properties: 
    Type: string

- `visibility` (optional)
  Type: TeamVisibility

  listable by members and org owners; "limited" teams are listable by

  user.
  
  allOf:
    Reference: [TeamVisibility](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/teamvisibility.md); Type: TeamVisibility

### Delete a package

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-packages-owner-type-name-delete`

# Delete a package

`DELETE /packages/{owner}/{type}/{name}`

Authentication (security requirement alternatives):

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },
  {
    "Token": []
  },
  {
    "AccessToken": []
  },
  {
    "AuthorizationHeaderToken": []
  },
  {
    "SudoParam": []
  },
  {
    "SudoHeader": []
  },
  {
    "TOTPHeader": []
  }
]
```

- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `owner` (path, string, required) - owner of the package
  Type: string

- `type` (path, string, required) - type of the package
  Type: string

- `name` (path, string, required) - name of the package
  Type: string

Responses:

- 204: APIEmpty is an empty response

- 404: APINotFound is a not found empty response

## Examples

### cURL

```bash
curl -X DELETE 'https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1/packages/string/string/string' \
  -H 'Authorization: Basic WU9VUl9VU0VSTkFNRTpZT1VSX1BBU1NXT1JE'
```

### JavaScript

```javascript
const response = await fetch('https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1/packages/string/string/string', {
  method: 'DELETE',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': 'Basic WU9VUl9VU0VSTkFNRTpZT1VSX1BBU1NXT1JE',
  },
});

const data = await response.text();
```

### Python

```python

    'https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1/packages/string/string/string',
    headers={
        'Authorization': 'Basic WU9VUl9VU0VSTkFNRTpZT1VSX1BBU1NXT1JE',
```

### Search for issues across the repositories that the user has access to

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-repos-issues-search-get`

# Search for issues across the repositories that the user has access to

`GET /repos/issues/search`

Authentication (security requirement alternatives):

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },
  {
    "Token": []
  },
  {
    "AccessToken": []
  },
  {
    "AuthorizationHeaderToken": []
  },
  {
    "SudoParam": []
  },
  {
    "SudoHeader": []
  },
  {
    "TOTPHeader": []
  }
]
```

- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `state` (query, string, optional) - State of the issue
  Type: string
  
  default: "open"
  
  enum: ["open","closed","all"]

- `labels` (query, string, optional) - Comma-separated list of label names. Fetch only issues that have any of these labels. Non existent labels are discarded.
  Type: string

- `milestones` (query, string, optional) - Comma-separated list of milestone names. Fetch only issues that have any of these milestones. Non existent milestones are discarded.
  Type: string

- `q` (query, string, optional) - Search string
  Type: string

- `type` (query, string, optional) - Filter by issue type
  Type: string
  
  enum: ["issues","pulls"]

- `since` (query, string, date-time, optional) - Only show issues updated after the given time (RFC 3339 format)
  Type: string, date-time

- `before` (query, string, date-time, optional) - Only show issues updated before the given time (RFC 3339 format)
  Type: string, date-time

- `assigned` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter issues or pulls assigned to the authenticated user
  Type: boolean
  
  default: false

- `created` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter issues or pulls created by the authenticated user
  Type: boolean
  
  default: false

- `mentioned` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter issues or pulls mentioning the authenticated user
  Type: boolean
  
  default: false

- `review_requested` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter pull requests where the authenticated user's review was requested
  Type: boolean
  
  default: false

- `reviewed` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter pull requests reviewed by the authenticated user
  Type: boolean
  
  default: false

- `owner` (query, string, optional) - Filter by repository owner
  Type: string

- `created_by` (query, string, optional) - Only show items which were created by the given user
  Type: string

- `team` (query, string, optional) - Filter by team (requires organization owner parameter)
  Type: string

- `page` (query, integer, optional) - Page number of results to return (1-based)
  Type: integer
  
  default: 1
  
  minimum: 1

- `limit` (query, integer, optional) - Number of items per page
  Type: integer
  
  minimum: 0

Responses:

- 200: IssueList

Content type: application/json

Type: Array<Issue>

Items:
  Reference: [Issue](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/issue.md); Type: Issue
  
  Issue represents an issue in a repository

- 400: APIError is error format response

- 422: APIValidationError is error format response related to input validation

## Examples

### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1/repos/issues/search?state=open&assigned=false&created=false&mentioned=false&review_requested=false&reviewed=false&page=1' \
  -H 'Authorization: Basic WU9VUl9VU0VSTkFNRTpZT1VSX1BBU1NXT1JE'
```

### JavaScript

```javascript
const response = await fetch('https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1/repos/issues/search?state=open&assigned=false&created=false&mentioned=false&review_requested=false&reviewed=false&page=1', {
  method: 'GET',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': 'Basic WU9VUl9VU0VSTkFNRTpZT1VSX1BBU1NXT1JE',
  },
});

const data = await response.text();
```

### Python

```python
import requests

response = requests.get(
    'https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1/repos/issues/search?state=open&assigned=false&created=false&mentioned=false&review_requested=false&reviewed=false&page=1',
    headers={
        'Authorization': 'Basic WU9VUl9VU0VSTkFNRTpZT1VSX1BBU1NXT1JE',
    },
)
print(response.text)
```

### Search for repositories

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-repos-search-get`

# Search for repositories

`GET /repos/search`

Authentication (security requirement alternatives):

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },
  {
    "Token": []
  },
  {
    "AccessToken": []
  },
  {
    "AuthorizationHeaderToken": []
  },
  {
    "SudoParam": []
  },
  {
    "SudoHeader": []
  },
  {
    "TOTPHeader": []
  }
]
```

- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `q` (query, string, optional) - keyword
  Type: string

- `topic` (query, boolean, optional) - Limit search to repositories with keyword as topic
  Type: boolean

- `includeDesc` (query, boolean, optional) - include search of keyword within repository description
  Type: boolean

- `uid` (query, integer, int64, optional) - search only for repos that the user with the given id owns or contributes to
  Type: integer, int64

- `priority_owner_id` (query, integer, int64, optional) - repo owner to prioritize in the results
  Type: integer, int64

- `team_id` (query, integer, int64, optional) - search only for repos that belong to the given team id
  Type: integer, int64

- `starredBy` (query, integer, int64, optional) - search only for repos that the user with the given id has starred
  Type: integer, int64

- `private` (query, boolean, optional) - include private repositories this user has access to (defaults to true)
  Type: boolean

- `is_private` (query, boolean, optional) - show only pubic, private or all repositories (defaults to all)
  Type: boolean

- `template` (query, boolean, optional) - include template repositories this user has access to (defaults to true)
  Type: boolean

- `archived` (query, boolean, optional) - show only archived, non-archived or all repositories (defaults to all)
  Type: boolean

- `mode` (query, string, optional) - type of repository to search for. Supported values are "fork", "source", "mirror" and "collaborative"
  Type: string

- `exclusive` (query, boolean, optional) - if `uid` is given, search only for repos that the user owns
  Type: boolean

- `sort` (query, string, optional) - sort repos by attribute. Supported values are "alpha", "created", "updated", "size", "git_size", "lfs_size", "stars", "forks" and "id". Default is "alpha"
  Type: string

- `order` (query, string, optional) - sort order, either "asc" (ascending) or "desc" (descending). Default is "asc", ignored if "sort" is not specified.
  Type: string

- `page` (query, integer, optional) - page number of results to return (1-based)
  Type: integer

- `limit` (query, integer, optional) - page size of results
  Type: integer

Responses:

- 200: 

- 422: APIValidationError is error format response related to input validation

## Examples

### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1/repos/search' \
  -H 'Authorization: Basic WU9VUl9VU0VSTkFNRTpZT1VSX1BBU1NXT1JE'
```

```javascript

  },

```

# Edit a repository's properties. Only fields that are set will be changed.

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },
  {
    "Token": []
  },
  {
    "AccessToken": []
  },
  {
    "AuthorizationHeaderToken": []
  },
  {
    "SudoParam": []
  },
  {
    "SudoHeader": []
  },
  {
    "TOTPHeader": []
  }
]
```

- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `owner` (path, string, required) - owner of the repo to edit
  Type: string

- `repo` (path, string, required) - name of the repo to edit
  Type: string

Request body: application/json

Properties of a repo that you can edit

Type: EditRepoOption

EditRepoOption options when editing a repository's properties

Schema: [EditRepoOption](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/editrepooption.md)

- `allow_fast_forward_only_merge` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to allow fast-forward-only merging pull requests, or `false` to prevent fast-forward-only merging.

- `allow_manual_merge` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to allow mark pr as merged manually, or `false` to prevent it.

- `allow_merge_commits` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to allow merging pull requests with a merge commit, or `false` to prevent merging pull requests with merge commits.

- `allow_merge_update` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to allow updating pull request branch by merge, or `false` to prevent it.

- `allow_rebase` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to allow rebase-merging pull requests, or `false` to prevent rebase-merging.

- `allow_rebase_explicit` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to allow rebase with explicit merge commits (--no-ff), or `false` to prevent rebase with explicit merge commits.

- `allow_rebase_update` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to allow updating pull request branch by rebase, or `false` to prevent it.

- `allow_squash_merge` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to allow squash-merging pull requests, or `false` to prevent squash-merging.

- `archived` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  set to `true` to archive this repository.

- `autodetect_manual_merge` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to enable AutodetectManualMerge, or `false` to prevent it. Note: In some special cases, misjudgments can occur.

- `default_allow_maintainer_edit` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  set to `true` to allow edits from maintainers by default

- `default_branch` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  sets the default branch for this repository.

- `default_delete_branch_after_merge` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  set to `true` to delete pr branch after merge by default

- `default_merge_style` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  set to a merge style to be used by this repository: "merge", "rebase", "rebase-merge", "squash", or "fast-forward-only".

- `default_update_style` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  set to an update style to be used by this repository: "merge" or "rebase".

- `description` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  a short description of the repository.

- `enable_prune` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  enable prune - remove obsolete remote-tracking references when mirroring

- `external_tracker` (optional)
  Reference: [ExternalTracker](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/externaltracker.md); Type: ExternalTracker
  
  ExternalTracker represents settings for external tracker

- `external_wiki` (optional)
  Reference: [ExternalWiki](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/externalwiki.md); Type: ExternalWiki
  
  ExternalWiki represents setting for external wiki

- `has_actions` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to enable actions unit, or `false` to disable them.

- `has_code` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to enable code for this repository or `false` to disable it.

- `has_issues` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to enable issues for this repository or `false` to disable them.

- `has_packages` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to enable packages unit, or `false` to disable them.

- `has_projects` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to enable project unit, or `false` to disable them.

- `has_pull_requests` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to allow pull requests, or `false` to prevent pull request.

- `has_releases` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to enable releases unit, or `false` to disable them.

- `has_wiki` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to enable the wiki for this repository or `false` to disable it.

- `ignore_whitespace_conflicts` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to ignore whitespace for conflicts, or `false` to not ignore whitespace.

- `internal_tracker` (optional)
  Reference: [InternalTracker](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/internaltracker.md); Type: InternalTracker
  
  InternalTracker represents settings for internal tracker

- `mirror_interval` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  set to a string like `8h30m0s` to set the mirror interval time

- `mirror_password` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  authentication password for the remote repository (mirrors)

- `mirror_token` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  authentication token for the remote repository (mirrors)

- `mirror_username` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  authentication username for the remote repository (mirrors)

- `name` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  name of the repository
  
  uniqueItems: true

- `private` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to make the repository private or `false` to make it public.
  Note: you will get a 422 error if the organization restricts changing repository visibility to organization
  owners and a non-owner tries to change the value of private.

- `projects_mode` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  `repo` to only allow repo-level projects, `owner` to only allow owner projects, `all` to allow both.

- `template` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  either `true` to make this repository a template or `false` to make it a normal repository

- `website` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  a URL with more information about the repository.

Responses:

- 200: 

- 403: APIForbiddenError is a forbidden error response

- 404: APINotFound is a not found empty response

- 422: APIValidationError is error format response related to input validation

### Lists all artifacts for a repository

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-repos-owner-repo-actions-artifacts-get`

# Lists all artifacts for a repository

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/artifacts`

Authentication (security requirement alternatives):

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },
  {
    "Token": []
  },
  {
    "AccessToken": []
  },
  {
    "AuthorizationHeaderToken": []
  },
  {
    "SudoParam": []
  },
  {
    "SudoHeader": []
  },
  {
    "TOTPHeader": []
  }
]
```

- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `owner` (path, string, required) - owner of the repo
  Type: string

- `repo` (path, string, required) - name of the repository
  Type: string

- `name` (query, string, optional) - name of the artifact
  Type: string

Responses:

- 200: 

- 400: APIError is error format response

- 404: APINotFound is a not found empty response

## Examples

### cURL

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1/repos/string/string/actions/artifacts' \

```

### Force-cancel a workflow run

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-repos-owner-repo-actions-runs-run-force-cancel-post`

# Force-cancel a workflow run

`POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run}/force-cancel`

Cancels a workflow run without waiting for its runners to acknowledge the cancellation.
The jobs are marked cancelled at once and anything a runner reports for them afterwards is discarded.
Only use this endpoint when the workflow run does not respond to `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run}/cancel`.


Authentication (security requirement alternatives):

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },
  {
    "Token": []
  },
  {
    "AccessToken": []
  },
  {
    "AuthorizationHeaderToken": []
  },
  {
    "SudoParam": []
  },
  {
    "SudoHeader": []
  },
  {
    "TOTPHeader": []
  }
]
```

- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `owner` (path, string, required) - owner of the repo
  Type: string

- `repo` (path, string, required) - name of the repository
  Type: string

- `run` (path, integer, required) - run ID
  Type: integer

Responses:

- 400: APIError is error format response

- `repo` (path, string, required) - name of the repo
  Type: string

- `page` (query, integer, optional) - page number of results to return (1-based)
  Type: integer

- `limit` (query, integer, optional) - page size of results, default maximum page size is 50
  Type: integer

Responses:

- 200: TasksList

Content type: application/json

Type: ActionTaskResponse

ActionTaskResponse returns a ActionTask

Schema: [ActionTaskResponse](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/actiontaskresponse.md)

- `total_count` (optional)
  Type: integer, int64
  
  TotalCount is the total number of workflow runs

- `workflow_runs` (optional)
  Type: Array<ActionTask>
  
  Entries contains the list of workflow runs
  
  Items:
    Reference: [ActionTask](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/actiontask.md); Type: ActionTask
    
    ActionTask represents a ActionTask

- 400: APIError is error format response

- 403: APIForbiddenError is a forbidden error response

- 409: APIConflict is a conflict empty response

- 422: APIValidationError is error format response related to input validation

  Type: string, date-time

- `state` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  State indicates if the workflow is active or disabled

- `updated_at` (optional)
  Type: string, date-time

- `url` (optional)
  Type: string, uri

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-repos-owner-repo-actions-workflows-workflow-id-dispatches-post`

# Create a workflow dispatch event

`POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/workflows/{workflow_id}/dispatches`

Authentication (security requirement alternatives):

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },
  {
    "Token": []
  },
  {
    "AccessToken": []
  },
  {
    "AuthorizationHeaderToken": []
  },
  {
    "SudoParam": []
  },
  {
    "SudoHeader": []
  },
  {
    "TOTPHeader": []
  }
]
```

- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `owner` (path, string, required) - owner of the repo
  Type: string

- `repo` (path, string, required) - name of the repo
  Type: string

- `workflow_id` (path, string, required) - id of the workflow
  Type: string

- `return_run_details` (query, boolean, optional) - Whether the response should include the workflow run ID and URLs.
  Type: boolean

- `scoped_workflow_source_repo_id` (query, integer, int64, optional) - For a scoped workflow, the ID of the source repository providing it; omit or 0 for a repo-level workflow.
  Type: integer, int64

Request body: application/json

Type: CreateActionWorkflowDispatch

CreateActionWorkflowDispatch represents the payload for triggering a workflow dispatch event

Schema: [CreateActionWorkflowDispatch](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/createactionworkflowdispatch.md)

- `inputs` (optional)
  Type: object
  
  Additional properties: 
    Type: string

- `ref` (required)
  Type: string
  
  Example:
  
  ```json
  "refs/heads/main"
  ```

Responses:

- 200: RunDetails

Content type: application/json

Type: RunDetails

RunDetails returns workflow_dispatch runid and url

Schema: [RunDetails](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/rundetails.md)

- `html_url` (optional)
  Type: string, uri

- `run_url` (optional)
  Type: string, uri

- `workflow_run_id` (optional)
  Type: integer, int64

- 204: No Content, if return_run_details is missing or false

- 400: APIError is error format response

- 403: APIForbiddenError is a forbidden error response

- 404: APINotFound is a not found empty response

- 422: APIValidationError is error format response related to input validation

### Update the priorities of branch protections for a repository.

# Update the priorities of branch protections for a repository.

`POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branch_protections/priority`

Authentication (security requirement alternatives):

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },
  {
    "Token": []
  },
  {
    "AccessToken": []
  },
  {
    "AuthorizationHeaderToken": []
  },
  {
    "SudoParam": []
  },
  {
    "SudoHeader": []
  },
  {
    "TOTPHeader": []
  }
]
```

- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `owner` (path, string, required) - owner of the repo
  Type: string

- `repo` (path, string, required) - name of the repo
  Type: string

Type: UpdateBranchProtectionPriories

UpdateBranchProtectionPriories a list to update the branch protection rule priorities

- `ids` (optional)
  Type: Array<integer>
  
  Items:
    Type: integer, int64

Responses:

- 204: APIEmpty is an empty response

- 404: APINotFound is a not found empty response

- 422: APIValidationError is error format response related to input validation

- 423: APIRepoArchivedError is an error that is raised when an archived repo should be modified

### List a repository's branches

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-repos-owner-repo-branches-get`

# List a repository's branches

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches`

Authentication (security requirement alternatives):

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },
  {
    "Token": []
  },
  {
    "AccessToken": []
  },
  {
    "AuthorizationHeaderToken": []
  },
  {
    "SudoParam": []
  },
  {
    "SudoHeader": []
  },
  {
    "TOTPHeader": []
  }
]
```

- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `owner` (path, string, required) - owner of the repo
  Type: string

- `repo` (path, string, required) - name of the repo
  Type: string

- `page` (query, integer, optional) - page number of results to return (1-based)
  Type: integer

- `limit` (query, integer, optional) - page size of results
  Type: integer

- `q` (query, string, optional) - branch name substring to filter by
  Type: string

Responses:

- 200: BranchList

Content type: application/json

Type: Array<Branch>

Items:
  Reference: [Branch](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/branch.md); Type: Branch
  
  Branch represents a repository branch

## Examples

### Create a branch

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-repos-owner-repo-branches-post`

# Create a branch

`POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches`

Authentication (security requirement alternatives):

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },
  {
    "Token": []
  },
  {
    "AccessToken": []
  },
  {
    "AuthorizationHeaderToken": []
  },
  {
    "SudoParam": []
  },
  {
    "SudoHeader": []
  },
  {
    "TOTPHeader": []
  }
]
```

- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `owner` (path, string, required) - owner of the repo
  Type: string

- `repo` (path, string, required) - name of the repo
  Type: string

Request body: application/json

Type: CreateBranchRepoOption

CreateBranchRepoOption options when creating a branch in a repository

Schema: [CreateBranchRepoOption](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/createbranchrepooption.md)

- `new_branch_name` (required)
  Type: string
  
  Name of the branch to create
  
  uniqueItems: true

- `old_branch_name` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Name of the old branch to create from
  
  uniqueItems: true

- `old_ref_name` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Name of the old branch/tag/commit to create from
  
  uniqueItems: true

Responses:

- 201: Branch

Content type: application/json

Type: Branch

Branch represents a repository branch

Schema: [Branch](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/branch.md)

- `commit` (optional)
  Reference: [PayloadCommit](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/payloadcommit.md); Type: PayloadCommit
  
  PayloadCommit represents a commit

- `effective_branch_protection_name` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  EffectiveBranchProtectionName is the name of the effective branch protection rule

- `enable_status_check` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  EnableStatusCheck indicates if status checks are enabled

- `name` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Name is the branch name

- `protected` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  Protected indicates if the branch is protected

- `required_approvals` (optional)
  Type: integer, int64
  
  RequiredApprovals is the number of required approvals for pull requests

- `status_check_contexts` (optional)
  Type: Array<string>
  
  StatusCheckContexts contains the list of required status check contexts
  
  Items:
    Type: string

- `user_can_merge` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  UserCanMerge indicates if the current user can merge to this branch

- `user_can_push` (optional)
  Type: boolean
  
  UserCanPush indicates if the current user can push to this branch

- 403: The branch is archived or a mirror.

- 404: The old branch does not exist.

- 409: The branch with the same name already exists.

- 423: APIRepoArchivedError is an error that is raised when an archived repo should be modified

## Examples

### cURL

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/GITEA-API-APP-SUBURL/api/v1/repos/string/string/branches' \

  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \

  "old_ref_name": "string"
}'
```

```json
[
  {
```

### Get a list of all commits from a repository

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-repos-owner-repo-commits-get`

# Get a list of all commits from a repository

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits`

Authentication (security requirement alternatives):

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },
  {
    "Token": []
  },
  {
    "AccessToken": []
  },
  {
    "AuthorizationHeaderToken": []
  },
  {
    "SudoParam": []
  },
  {
    "SudoHeader": []
  },
  {
    "TOTPHeader": []
  }
]
```

- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `owner` (path, string, required) - owner of the repo
  Type: string

- `repo` (path, string, required) - name of the repo
  Type: string

- `sha` (query, string, optional) - SHA or branch to start listing commits from (usually 'master')
  Type: string

- `path` (query, string, optional) - filepath of a file/dir
  Type: string

- `since` (query, string, date-time, optional) - Only commits after this date will be returned (ISO 8601 format)
  Type: string, date-time

- `until` (query, string, date-time, optional) - Only commits before this date will be returned (ISO 8601 format)
  Type: string, date-time

- `stat` (query, boolean, optional) - include diff stats for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true')
  Type: boolean

- `verification` (query, boolean, optional) - include verification for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true')
  Type: boolean

- `files` (query, boolean, optional) - include a list of affected files for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true')
  Type: boolean

- `page` (query, integer, optional) - page number of results to return (1-based)
  Type: integer

- `limit` (query, integer, optional) - page size of results (ignored if used with 'path')
  Type: integer

- `not` (query, string, optional) - commits that match the given specifier will not be listed.
  Type: string

Responses:

- 200: CommitList

Content type: application/json

Type: Array<Commit>

Items:
  Reference: [Commit](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/commit.md); Type: Commit

- 404: APINotFound is a not found empty response

- 409: EmptyRepository

Content type: application/json

Type: APIError

APIError is an api error with a message

Schema: [APIError](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/apierror.md)

- `message` (optional)
  Type: string
  
  Message contains the error description

- `url` (optional)
  Type: string, uri
  
  URL contains the documentation URL for this error

### Get a commit's statuses, by branch/tag/commit reference

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-repos-owner-repo-commits-ref-statuses-get`

# Get a commit's statuses, by branch/tag/commit reference

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/{ref}/statuses`

Authentication (security requirement alternatives):

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },
  {
    "Token": []
  },
  {
    "AccessToken": []
  },
  {
    "AuthorizationHeaderToken": []
  },
  {
    "SudoParam": []
  },
  {
    "SudoHeader": []
  },
  {
    "TOTPHeader": []
  }
]
```

- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `owner` (path, string, required) - owner of the repo
  Type: string

- `repo` (path, string, required) - name of the repo
  Type: string

- `ref` (path, string, required) - name of branch/tag/commit
  Type: string

- `sort` (query, string, optional) - type of sort
  Type: string
  
  enum: ["oldest","recentupdate","leastupdate","leastindex","highestindex"]

- `state` (query, string, optional) - type of state
  Type: string
  
  enum: ["pending","success","error","failure","warning"]

- `page` (query, integer, optional) - page number of results to return (1-based)
  Type: integer

- `limit` (query, integer, optional) - page size of results
  Type: integer

Responses:

- 200: CommitStatusList

Content type: application/json

Type: Array<CommitStatus>

Items:
  Reference: [CommitStatus](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/commitstatus.md); Type: CommitStatus
  
  CommitStatus holds a single status of a single Commit

- 400: APIError is error format response

- 404: APINotFound is a not found empty response

### Get commit comparison information

Path: `/gitea-api-docs/api/operations/operation-repos-owner-repo-compare-basehead-get`

# Get commit comparison information

`GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/compare/{basehead}`

By default returns JSON commit comparison information. The raw diff or patch can be
requested with the `output` query parameter set to `diff` or `patch` respectively.


Authentication (security requirement alternatives):

```json
[
  {
    "BasicAuth": []
  },
  {
    "Token": []
  },
  {
    "AccessToken": []
  },
  {
    "AuthorizationHeaderToken": []
  },
  {
    "SudoParam": []
  },
  {
    "SudoHeader": []
  },
  {
    "TOTPHeader": []
  }
]
```

- BasicAuth: http (basic)
- Token: apiKey, query token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AccessToken: apiKey, query access_token. This authentication option is deprecated for removal in Gitea 1.23. Please use AuthorizationHeaderToken instead.
- AuthorizationHeaderToken: apiKey, header Authorization. API tokens must be prepended with "token" followed by a space.
- SudoParam: apiKey, query sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- SudoHeader: apiKey, header Sudo. Sudo API request as the user provided as the key. Admin privileges are required.
- TOTPHeader: apiKey, header X-GITEA-OTP. Must be used in combination with BasicAuth if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Parameters:

- `owner` (path, string, required) - owner of the repo
  Type: string

- `repo` (path, string, required) - name of the repo
  Type: string

- `basehead` (path, string, required) - compare two refs as `base...head` (or `base..head`); refs may be branches, tags, full or short SHAs (including branch names that contain slashes), optionally with a `^` or `~N` revision suffix.
  Type: string

- `output` (query, string, optional) - return the raw comparison as `diff` or `patch` instead of JSON
  Type: string
  
  enum: ["diff","patch"]

- `verification` (query, boolean, optional) - include verification for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true')
  Type: boolean

- `files` (query, boolean, optional) - include a list of affected files for every commit (disable for speedup, default 'true')
  Type: boolean

Responses:

- 200: 

Content type: application/json

Type: Compare

Schema: [Compare](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/compare.md)

- `commits` (optional)
  Type: Array<Commit>
  
  Items:
    Reference: [Commit](https://ghulammujtabaquotex-cloud.github.io/gitea-api-docs/api/models/commit.md); Type: Commit

- `total_commits` (optional)
  Type: integer, int64

- 400: APIError is error format response

- 404: APINotFound is a not found empty response


# Gets the metadata of all the entries of the root dir.

This API follows GitHub's design, and it is not easy to use. Recommend users to use our "contents-ext" API instead.
